description: This file contains test suites for Vitest configuration and utility functions, including tests for resolving worker limits, scheduling logic, parsing process statistics, and default config settings.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Provides the default pool type ('threads') for Vitest testing.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of local workers based on host resources and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Determines scheduling parameters such as maxWorkers and parallelism based on system load and other active Vitest processes.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Analyzes process list data to count active Vitest roots and workers, and computes CPU percentage usage.
